headline: 10-Year Yield Fell 13 Basis Points to 5.06 Percent
narrative: The 10-year Treasury yield fell 13 basis points to 5.06 percent from 5.19 percent. That yield is the price of long-term government borrowing, and the drop means buyers paid higher prices for the long bond, putting money into duration. The 2-year yield, the short-rate pipe, was 4.08 percent from 4.09 percent, and the gap between the two rates narrowed to 0.98 from 1.1.
author: jordan
